name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2122: Queue 32 138 135 139 136. Two deleters gave opposite answers about the same footage: the frame deleter refuses to remove a single frame while there is no durable witness index, and the reel deleter, which removes the whole reel those frames live in, never asked. Measured on a fixture with both lanes sealed and no durable store, frames offered zero and reels offered eight. The batch filing door added in v2118 was gated on uniques or sets, and a vaulted base lands in neither, so the one case that most needs filing was the one that never filed. Also repaired a retention gate that had been red for nine cases because a reel id it builds collides with a literal another test file names, so the fixture protection rule was claiming the suite own fixtures.
